entries.title: PROMETHEAN SUN
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: Before the Heresy, Vulkan and his Salamanders face a xenos threat that tests their humanity and martial prowess.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Salamanders face a xenos menace before the galaxy descends into civil war.

entries.title: IMMORTAL DUTY
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: Salamanders survivors honor their duty to protect humanity despite their Legion's shattering.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XVIII Legion maintains their humanitarian values even in defeat.

entries.title: SCORCHED EARTH
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: After Isstvan V, Salamanders survivors wage war across scorched worlds, searching for their lost Primarch.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XVIII Legion fights through devastation, seeking Vulkan amid the ruins.

entries.title: SONS OF THE FORGE
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: Numeon leads the quest to recover Vulkan's body, the Salamanders refusing to believe their Primarch can truly die.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Pyre Guard undertake a desperate mission to recover their fallen Primarch.

entries.title: ARTEFACTS
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: Salamanders recover precious relics from the war's devastation.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XVIII Legion seeks to preserve artifacts from destruction.

entries.title: IMMORTAL DUTY
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: Salamanders survivors honor their duty to protect humanity despite their Legion's shattering.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XVIII Legion maintains their humanitarian values even in defeat.

entries.title: UNFORGED
entries.author: Guy Haley
entries.currentBlurb: Iron Hands struggle with their identity after losing their Primarch and much of their Legion.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Survivors of the X Legion grapple with who they are without Ferrus Manus.

entries.title: GREY TALON
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: Raven Guard survivors strike from the shadows, their talons still sharp despite their losses.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XIX Legion's remnants prove they remain deadly even shattered.

entries.title: MEDUSON
entries.author: Dan Abnett
entries.currentBlurb: Shadrak Meduson leads Iron Hands survivors in brutal strikes against the traitors, becoming a legend among the shattered Legions.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: An Iron Hands warrior leads survivors in guerrilla warfare, striking fear into the traitors.

entries.title: THE KEYS OF HEL
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: The shattered Legions seek the Keys of Hel, a weapon that could turn the tide of war.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Survivors from three Legions unite to secure a powerful weapon.

entries.title: DEEDS ENDURE
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: Raven Guard deeds endure beyond death as survivors carry on their fallen brothers' missions.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XIX Legion honors their dead by continuing the fight.

entries.title: THE NOOSE
entries.author: David Annandale
entries.currentBlurb: Iron Hands survivors tighten the noose around traitor supply lines.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The X Legion disrupts traitor operations through calculated strikes.

entries.title: UNSPOKEN
entries.author: Guy Haley
entries.currentBlurb: Unspoken oaths drive Iron Hands survivors to ever more desperate acts of vengeance.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The X Legion's rage manifests in increasingly brutal attacks.

entries.title: THE EITHER
entries.author: Graham McNeill
entries.currentBlurb: Iron Hands survivors face an impossible choice between duty and vengeance.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The X Legion must decide between conflicting loyalties.

entries.title: THE HAND ELECT
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: The chosen warriors of the Iron Hands elite continue their mission despite overwhelming losses.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Elite Iron Hands survivors press on against impossible odds.

entries.title: THE SEVENTH SERPENT
entries.author: Graham McNeill
entries.currentBlurb: The Alpha Legion's schemes intersect with the shattered Legions' vengeance, with no one certain of anyone's true allegiance.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Alpha Legion machinations complicate the survivors' war of vengeance.
